Publish.LongDescription:
# 🏕️ 🛣️🛻
### Parks, Roads + Lane Wear
Take control of park maintenance, road repair trucks, and lane wear.
### Adjust - **Park maintenance:** depot fleet size, work capacity, and work rate - **Road repair:** depot fleet size, work capacity, and repair rate - **Lane wear:** make roads deteriorate slower or faster. Damaged roads make vehicles drive slower.
Each feature works independently, and **100% = game default**.
- Safe to remove anytime. All vanilla, no Harmony patches; more reliable on game patch days. - Parts of Parks and Roads was originally in [All Transit + Trucks](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/138390/Windows) mod (ATT). Players asked for Parks/Roads to be separate to reduce confusion.
See the in-game Options tooltips for more details.
### Support and Feedback
- Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right). No donations requested. - Feedback and PRs welcome through the GitHub and Discord links (icons on the right).
